comment: Django REST framework on Django over WSGI, served by gunicorn as flask is, because DRF's views are synchronous. One module of views per family under Implementation/views, routed by urls.py, and the items resource a ViewSet that DRF's SimpleRouter routes. gunicorn runs two worker processes of four threads each, because one Python process runs Python on one core at a time and the container has two. On container-h2 gunicorn serves HTTP/2 with prior knowledge itself, with its http2 extra. On lambda-emulator the application answers behind apig-wsgi, in one process. settings.py keeps JSONRenderer alone of DRF's two default renderers and no authentication classes, and keeps two of the seven middleware classes startproject installs: CorsMiddleware for the cors family and CommonMiddleware, which writes Content-Length. DRF has no cache, compression, conditional requests or middleware of its own, so those families put Django's view decorators on the function @api_view wraps, where DRF's caching guide puts cache_page. No framework document or client: DRF's own schema generator is deprecated in favour of drf-spectacular, a third-party package. The suite is UnitTests/, pytest over DRF's APIClient, and never reaches the image. The suite and upgrade run through uv, which has to be installed.

unsupported.sse.medium: apig-wsgi buffers the whole answer, so the events arrive as one body.
unsupported.stream.ndjson: apig-wsgi buffers the whole answer, so the rows arrive as one body.

noHandler.cors.preflight: django-cors-headers' CorsMiddleware answers the preflight before the URLconf is consulted, and no view runs.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: Django's URL resolver finds no pattern, and Django answers with its default 404 page.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: The items ViewSet has no action for POST on /items/<int:pk>, and DRF answers 405 with MethodNotAllowed.

authorized.mechanism: A DRF permission class on the view, which compares the bearer token with settings.json's and refuses any other with DRF's 403 before the view runs

baseline.mechanism: PlainTextRenderer on the view, the custom renderer DRF's renderer guide writes as its example, which sends the string as text/plain

body.mechanism: DRF Serializers over request.data, which DRF's JSONParser parsed: types alone on the bind routes and orderRequest's rules on the validate routes, refused with DRF's 400 through is_valid(raise_exception=True). The first-error route's serializer overrides to_internal_value to stop at the first field that fails, because a serializer cannot

cache.mechanism: Django's cache_page on the function @api_view wraps, as DRF's caching guide places it, over LocMemCache, one store in each worker. vary_on_headers names the headers each vary row is keyed on

compressed.mechanism: Django's gzip_page on the function @api_view wraps, because DRF compresses nothing, at its fixed threshold of 200 bytes and at gzip level 6, which Django hard-codes

cors.mechanism: django-cors-headers' CorsMiddleware, kept to /cors/ by CORS_URLS_REGEX, as DRF's documentation recommends

errors.builtin: Django's URL resolver answers a path no pattern matches with its default HTML 404 page. Inside a view, DRF's exception handler answers the items ViewSet's NotFound with 404, a method with no action with 405, and a body JSONParser cannot parse with 400, each as JSON with a detail message.

etag.mechanism: Django's ConditionalGetMiddleware, scoped to the two functions @api_view wraps with decorator_from_middleware, because DRF computes no validator. It hashes the rendered body with MD5 and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.builtin: DRF's FormParser and MultiPartParser parse both bodies into request.data, and a Serializer binds the fields and the upload.

headers.builtin: The view reads request.headers by name and converts the account with int(), because DRF binds no header.

items.mechanism: A ViewSet with an action per method, which DRF's SimpleRouter routes. DRF answers HEAD with retrieve and a method with no action with 405, and a Serializer binds each body, with partial=True on the patch

json.builtin: A view returns a Response holding the payload, which DRF's JSONRenderer, the one renderer settings.py keeps, writes with the standard library's json.

middleware.mechanism: A no-op Django middleware whose process_request returns None, made a view decorator with decorator_from_middleware, four or sixteen times on the function @api_view wraps, because DRF has no middleware of its own

parameters.builtin: Django's <int:...> path converter, which matches digits and hands the DRF view an int.

query.builtin: A DRF Serializer over request.query_params, which binds and converts each value.

sse.mechanism: Django's StreamingHttpResponse typed text/event-stream, over a generator that frames each row as one event, because DRF has no event stream of its own. EventStreamRenderer on the view lets DRF's content negotiation accept the request

static.mechanism: django.views.static.serve over the payload directory, because DRF serves no files

stream.builtin: Django's StreamingHttpResponse typed application/x-ndjson, over a generator that renders each row with DRF's JSONRenderer, because DRF's Response renders the whole body at once.

template.mechanism: DRF's TemplateHTMLRenderer on the view, which renders the template the Response names with Django's template language, through the DjangoTemplates backend the TEMPLATES setting configures
